config.script:
selectedReasonID=self.view.params.ReasonID
	selectedReasonName=self.view.params.label
	action= "confirm"
	if selectedReasonID ==8 :
		params = {	"action": action,
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for a Break !",
				"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
				"label":selectedReasonName}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Lunch", 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
	elif selectedReasonID ==9 :
		params = {	"action": action,
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for Lunch Break !",
				"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
				"label":selectedReasonName}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Lunch", 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
	else :	
		params={"ReasonID":selectedReasonID,"ReasonName":selectedReasonName}
		system.perspective.navigate(view='Project/Operator/Operator/downtime_confirm', params=params)
